rationale: Formal direct check of the accepted unit unit-claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append for obligation claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append. The obligation requires that a configuration installed as configurations.latest must have its entry in the durable log. The plan admits one leader-established operation (assurance_leader_established with alias adm) and one membership-change attempt (assurance_config_change_attempt with alias act), then inspects the result event assurance_config_published emitted for that same operation (identity field node). The property asserts entry_durable is true whenever the configuration was published ahead of a durable entry (trigger published_ahead_of_durable true). The harness bootstraps one voter over an InmemStore whose StoreLogs can be failed on demand at the real LogStore boundary, waits for leadership, emits the two prerequisites, runs AddVoter while exactly one StoreLogs call fails, then reports whether the log index assigned to that change is present in the store; previous clean-copy runs of the same harness observed add_voter_error set, assigned index 4 absent from the store, and the published configuration listing a second voter. Only one failing StoreLogs timing is exercised here, and the failure is an explicitly supplied fault rather than a producer-generated condition; both are recorded as plan uncertainties. The plan and harness are submitted as separate draft files; plan.harness.source and files are intentionally omitted so the controller fixes the harness bytes.
